# Copilot instructions

For this repo, follow the project-specific guidance in [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md).

Key defaults:
- Use the root `Makefile` targets for dev/test/lint (`make up`, `make test-backend`, `make lint`).
- Backend work happens in `backend/` (FastAPI + Celery); frontend work happens in `frontend/` (Next.js).
- Prefer linking to existing docs (READMEs, workflows) rather than copying them into chat.
